environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate, connecting through PgBouncer 1.21 in transaction pooling mode with server-side prepared statement disabling (server_reset_query = DISCARD ALL) and a custom query filter plugin (pgbouncer-rr with route rules). PgBouncer configuration sets disable_pqexec=1 forcing extended query protocol only, and includes ignore_startup_parameters=extra_float_digits with max_client_conn=100. The downstream PostgreSQL 15 instance has a restricted role (SELECT-only on specific tables via GRANT) and pg_stat_statements tracking with log_min_duration_statement=0. Additionally, the RDS instance has a custom parameter group with statement_timeout=5000 and idle_in_transaction_session_timeout=10000.

config.connection: via PgBouncer 1.21 on port 6432, transaction pooling mode

pgbouncer_config.query_routing: pgbouncer-rr with deny rules for multi-statement and DDL patterns

config.db_role: app_readonly_user with SELECT-only GRANT on users, user_activity, access_log(INSERT only)
